Cards

Standard Card
Basic card with border and surface background. Used for feature sections and content blocks.
Elevated Card
Card with shadow for higher elevation. Use sparingly for primary content focus.
Flat Card
Border-top only, no background. Ideal for dense dashboards and data-heavy layouts.
Accent Card
Highlighted card with accent border and tinted background. Draws attention to important actions.
